name: GUI-World
description: GUI-World is a video benchmark and dataset for multimodal GUI-oriented understanding, covering six GUI scenarios and eight types of GUI-oriented questions in three formats. It evaluates the ability of multimodal LLMs to understand dynamic and sequential GUI content, including desktop software and multi-window interactions.
typical_sota_score: varies by question type; recent multimodal models report roughly 50–80% accuracy depending on format and scenario
reputation: A recent benchmark for multimodal GUI understanding that is emerging in the GUI-agent and multimodal LLM community, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on dynamic GUI content understanding; dataset and code publicly available.
